en: An old black‑and‑white photograph of a large three‑storey building with a central pediment and steep tiled roof, likely a school or civic building. The façade has many tall rectangular windows with external sunshades and a rusticated stone ground floor. In front is an open square or schoolyard with several young boys and girls standing and walking, some in darker city clothing and others in light, possibly regional or folk-style dress. Small trees line the edge of the square.
